name: Tripolitanian Republic (1918–1922)
description: A sky-blue field with a green palm tree beneath a white five-pointed star.
history: The Tripolitanian Republic, proclaimed in November 1918, was the first formally declared republic in the Arab world; it was extinguished by the Italian reconquest by 1923. This sky-blue palm-and-star design is an unreferenced reconstruction popularised by worldstatesmen.org: Wikimedia Commons categorises the file as a fictional flag, and Flags of the World records only that the republic's flag bore a crescent and star of uncertain colour.
